text:
Alex Chen: Hey team — heads up, I'm unexpectedly OOO tomorrow morning (family emergency). I can cover until 09:30 PST but need someone to take primary from 09:30–17:30 PST (covers EU evening). Sorry for the short notice :worried:
Priya Nair: @Alex Chen no worries. I can take primary from 09:30–13:30 PST, then need to hand off to someone in EU/APAC for the later window. Who's available for the 13:30–17:30 PST slot?
Jordan Lee: I can pick up 13:30–17:30 PST but only if someone can shadow for the first 15m of the handoff (still on another call until ~13:45).
Samir Patel: I can be secondary for the whole day and cover any escalation if needed. I can also be primary from 15:30–17:30 PST if that helps.
Alex Chen: Thanks all. Plan: Alex primary until 09:30, Priya primary 09:30–13:30, Jordan 13:30–15:30 primary, Samir 15:30–17:30 primary with Samir as secondary until 17:30. Can everyone confirm? Also important: our EU customers have a batch of nightly evaluation jobs that start 14:00 CET — runbook says to watch the job-runner queue and API error rate dashboards.
Priya Nair: Confirmed for me. Can you paste the quick handoff checklist? I want to ensure I have the right dashboards and API keys.
Alex Chen: Handoff checklist (copy/paste):
```
- Verify you can access console (SSO) and customer-logs (S3 role: inference-logs-read)
- Open dashboards: /console/metrics/latency, /console/alerts/error-rate, /console/routes/eu
- Pager routes: primary -> PagerDuty escalation policy "redwood-inference-prod"
- Known mitigations: toggle routing fallback to small-quant model (via console -> routing -> fallback)
- Runbooks: https://confluence.redwood/runbooks/eval-job-failures and https://confluence.redwood/runbooks/api-5xx
- Contact list: eng-oncall channel, oncall rotation page, support@redwood
```
Jordan Lee: Got the checklist. I have console access but don't have the S3 role to pull raw logs — Samir can you confirm you have it?
Samir Patel: I have the S3 role. I can pull logs and grep for "KVCache miss" or "OMP error" if needed. Also I can reassign the PagerDuty if someone forgets: `pd-override --policy redwood-inference-prod --assignee Jordan`
oncall-bot: Incident reminder: scheduled maintenance window in eu-west at 14:00 CET. If you see >3% 5xx for 5m, follow runbook: /runbooks/api-5xx and escalate to SEV2.
Priya Nair: Noted. Two questions: (1) Is there a known flaky model variant that spikes CPU during eval jobs? (2) Any active rollouts today?
Alex Chen: (1) The quantized tgi-3b-v2 has a history of transient OOMs on 8GB nodes when batch size > 4 — if you see high OOM counts, toggle to tgi-3b-v2-q4f16-alt. (2) No active canaries in prod right now. Last deploy was yesterday and deploy-bot reported success.
deploy-bot: Deploy report: release/2026-03-13-optimization completed — no rollback events.
Jordan Lee: Quick handoff note for logs: use this query in logs explorer to filter eval-job errors: `service:eval-runner AND status:failed AND env:prod` — then expand `job.payload` to see customer id.
Priya Nair: If I get paged and need to escalate, what's the matrix? I have no admin privileges for key mgmt.
Alex Chen: Escalation matrix: primary -> secondary -> oncall-sre -> engineering manager. For KMS/HSM issues open a ticket with security and ping @Samir. KMS emergency phone number is in the rotation doc.
Samir Patel: I'll grant Priya temporary key-access for tomorrow morning — giving you `kms-read` for the 09:30–13:30 window. I'll DM the request.
Priya Nair: Thanks Samir. One more — can someone approve a short pager override if the assignment doesn't land before 09:30? PD auto-assign sometimes bugs out.
Jordan Lee: I can approve override at 09:25 if needed.
Alex Chen: Great. Last thing: if you see persistent latency for hosted api in eu-region, enable the routing fallback for the affected route and notify support with `#support` tag so they can contact affected customers. Template: "[EU outage] 5xx spike affecting X customers, fallback enabled, investigation in progress".
Priya Nair: Copy that. I'll post that template if we need it.
Jordan Lee: One tiny ask — can someone add a short note on the rotation page about the handoff times? I edited it but don't have perm.
Samir Patel: Done. I added the handoff windows and linked the runbooks.
Alex Chen: Thanks everyone and really appreciate the cover. I'll be reachable by DM until 09:30. If anything critical after that, escalate as planned. :pray:
